annotation.bound_parties_text: The working paper is a state position paper that encourages countries and parties to act but imposes no binding obligations on anyone.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Countries should uphold a national defense policy that is defensive in nature, develop and use AI technologies in the military domain in a prudent and responsible manner
annotation.dates_quote: Working Paper of the People's Republic of China on (July 2022)
